strings.zh: 常磐森林是{NEWLINE}天然的迷宫呢。{CLEAR}小心别迷路啊！
strings.en: Viridian Forest is like a maze inside.{NEWLINE}Be careful. Don’t get lost in there.

strings.zh: 关东和城都各有一个巨大的森林,{NEWLINE}分别是常磐森林和桐树林。{CLEAR}但是常磐森林栖息的口袋妖怪{CLEAR}以虫系和飞行系为主,{CLEAR}而桐树林则以草系为主。
strings.en: Kanto and Johto each have a huge{NEWLINE}forest: Viridian Forest and Ilex Forest.{SCROLL}But the Pokémon living in Viridian Forest{NEWLINE}are mostly Bug and Flying types, while{CLEAR}Ilex Forest is mostly home to Grass{CLEAR}types.

strings.zh: 对战的规则分为{NEWLINE}「交替战斗」和「连续战斗」。{SCROLL}「交替战斗」模式相对简单,{NEWLINE}如果你对自己的实力有信心,{CLEAR}可以尝试在「设定」里面{CLEAR}把「战斗规则」改为「连续战斗」,{CLEAR}会让你获得更加刺激的对战体验。
strings.en: There are two battle styles: ‘Shift’{NEWLINE}and ‘Set.’{SCROLL}‘Shift’ is the easier one. If you’re{NEWLINE}confident in your skills, try going into{CLEAR}‘Options’...{SCROLL}...and changing ‘Battle Style’ to ‘Set.’{NEWLINE}It’ll make your battles way more{CLEAR}thrilling.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | 交替战斗/连续战斗/战斗规则/设定 → Shift/Set/Battle Style/Options (as 0043).

strings.zh: 我的布鲁跑到常磐森林里去了,{NEWLINE}可是那里到处都是虫系口袋,{CLEAR}我根本不敢过去找它。
strings.en: My Snubbull ran off into Viridian Forest,{NEWLINE}but it’s crawling with Bug Pokémon in{CLEAR}there.{SCROLL}I’m way too scared to go look for it.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | 布鲁 = Snubbull (the species; v3 read it as a name 'Blue'). Snubbull quest continues in 0130 #132–138.

strings.zh: 要买一点吗？
strings.en: Want to buy some?

strings.zh: 1个 撒网球{NEWLINE}1200元
strings.en: 1 Net Ball{NEWLINE}$1200

strings.zh: 3个 撒网球{NEWLINE}3600元
strings.en: 3 Net Balls{NEWLINE}$3600

strings.zh: 5个 撒网球{NEWLINE}6000元
strings.en: 5 Net Balls{NEWLINE}$6000

strings.zh: 10个 撒网球{NEWLINE}12000元
strings.en: 10 Net Balls{NEWLINE}$12000

strings.zh: 不买了
strings.en: No thanks

strings.zh: 需要的话再来哦！
strings.en: Come back if you need more!

strings.zh: 祝你抓虫成功！
strings.en: Good luck catching bugs!

strings.zh: 哇！一次买这么多！{NEWLINE}那大叔给你打个9折。{SCROLL}球拿好,祝你抓虫成功！
strings.en: Whoa! Buying that many at once! Then{NEWLINE}this old guy’ll give you 10% off.{SCROLL}Here are your balls. Good luck catching{NEWLINE}bugs!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: voice: 大叔 self-reference kept

strings.zh: 没拿够钱的话,大叔可不卖啊！
strings.en: If you didn’t bring enough money, this{NEWLINE}old guy isn’t selling!
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position | RV010: omission: 没拿够钱 and 大叔 kept

strings.zh: 看你很有本事的样子,{NEWLINE}如果你能帮我把布鲁找回来,{CLEAR}我就给你两万块当作报酬怎么样？{CLEAR}心动的话就快去找狗吧。
strings.en: You look pretty capable. If you can{NEWLINE}bring my Snubbull back...{SCROLL}...I’ll pay you $20000 as a reward. How{NEWLINE}about it?{SCROLL}If you’re interested, go find my dog.

strings.zh: 无论这只布鲁多么不听话,{NEWLINE}只要根据巴浦洛夫的条件反射原理{CLEAR}用食物或痛疼去刺激它,{CLEAR}它最终都会成为我的乖宠物,{CLEAR}哟呵呵呵。
strings.en: No matter how disobedient that Snubbull{NEWLINE}is, if I use Pavlov’s conditioned{CLEAR}reflexes...{SCROLL}...and train it with food or pain, it’ll{NEWLINE}end up as my obedient pet. Oh ho ho ho.

strings.zh: 你是不打算帮我找回布鲁了？{NEWLINE}居然跟酬金过不去,{CLEAR}没见过你这么傻的人。
strings.en: You’re not going to help me get my{NEWLINE}Snubbull back? Turning down a reward...{SCROLL}I’ve never met anyone so dumb.

strings.zh: 布鲁『S——nu……{SCROLL}布鲁似乎很紧张。
strings.en: Snubbull: S-nu...{SCROLL}Snubbull seems very nervous.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags page_breaks_lost

strings.zh: 哇哇哇,{NEWLINE}你这不是带着熔岩蜗牛吗,{CLEAR}快让我摸摸。{SCROLL}……{SCROLL}……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Isn’t that a{NEWLINE}Magcargo you’ve got there?{SCROLL}Quick, let me touch it!{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 啊啊啊,好烫好烫,{NEWLINE}被烫伤了。{CLEAR}原来这就是熔岩蜗牛的皮肤吗？{CLEAR}真是充满了火焰的力量。{CLEAR}谢谢你让我摸到了真的熔岩蜗牛,{CLEAR}这个作为谢礼送给你。
strings.en: Aaah! Hot, hot, hot! I got burned!{SCROLL}So this is what Magcargo’s skin is like?{NEWLINE}It’s truly filled with the power of fire.{SCROLL}Thanks for letting me touch a real{NEWLINE}Magcargo. Take this as thanks.

strings.zh: 好想摸一下熔岩蜗牛看看啊,{NEWLINE}那种被火焰充满的皮肤,{CLEAR}质感一定很棒吧？
strings.en: I really want to touch a Magcargo.{SCROLL}That skin filled with flames must feel{NEWLINE}amazing, right?

strings.zh: 北　尼比市{NEWLINE}南　常磐市{SCROLL}我跟看板似的呢。
strings.en: North: Pewter City{NEWLINE}South: Viridian City{SCROLL}I’m just like a signpost.
strings.notes: v3 TM: 1 source(s), same position, flags fullwidth_chars

strings.zh: 虽然我很喜欢{NEWLINE}火系口袋妖怪那种灼热的感觉,{CLEAR}但是被烧伤的话确实挺麻烦的。
strings.en: I love the scorching feel of Fire-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon...{SCROLL}...but getting burned really is a pain.
